name: Ah! My Girlfriend is a Demon Summoned from the Depths of Hell!
source:
An abnormal high school student suffering from an incurable case of chuunibyou syndrome (Eighth Grade Syndrome) fancies himself an all-powerful demon lord reincarnate! But when, beyond all logic and reason, he successfully manages to summon a living, breathing demon of Hell, his life is turned upside down! What crazy hijinks will ensue when his house is filled to the brim with hellspawn!?

Presented by Watercress Studios and produced by a team of 20+ contributors for the [url=https://itch.io/jam/maximum-monster-month]Maximum Monster Month Game Jam[/url] (#MonMax), Ah! My Girlfriend is a Demon Summoned from the Depths of Hell is a uniquely comedic departure, with emphasis on self-aware comedy, anchored on its absurd premise. 

[From [url=https://watercress.itch.io/ah-my-girlfriend-is-a-demon-summoned-from-the-depths-of-hell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个患有无法治愈的中二病（中学二年级症候群）的异常高中生，自认为是无所不能的魔王转世！然而，超越一切逻辑与常识的事情发生了：他成功召唤出真正活生生的地狱恶魔，人生彻底颠倒！当家里挤满地狱生物后，究竟会发生怎样的疯狂闹剧！？

《啊！我的女友是从地狱深渊召唤出的恶魔！》由水芹工作室推出，20多名贡献者共同制作，参加[url=https://itch.io/jam/maximum-monster-month]Maximum Monster Month Game Jam[/url]（#MonMax）。作品以荒诞前提为核心，强调自觉式喜剧，是一部独具风格的搞笑作品。

[来源：[url=https://watercress.itch.io/ah-my-girlfriend-is-a-demon-summoned-from-the-depths-of-hell]Itch.io[/url]]
